issues.impact: Command path ambiguity; clients may call wrong endpoint

fix.strategy: Standardize to /api/commands, add compatibility alias if necessary.

acceptance_criteria: All clients use /api/commands and receive expected schema responses.

issues.impact: Pairing flow ambiguity; QR and confirm paths diverge
issues.description: Pairing endpoint mismatch: /pair vs /api/pair/confirm, and /api/pair/request not defined in JSON interface index.

spec_evidence.path_or_quote: Step: Agent pairing request ... method: POST /api/pair/request

fix.strategy: Define /api/pair/request in formal JSON specs and standardize /api/pair/confirm as the mobile endpoint.

acceptance_criteria: QR token generated by agent is accepted by /api/pair/confirm and results in device ownership linkage.

issues.impact: Device activation signaling undefined; agent may never receive cert/config
issues.description: System flow references /webhook/device/paired and /device/activate, but FastAPI↔Laravel spec does not define them.

fix.strategy: Either add these endpoints to the FastAPI↔Laravel spec or remove them from flow docs and use existing online/offline webhooks.

acceptance_criteria: Device activation path is specified in a single authoritative place and implemented consistently.

issues.impact: Dispatch reliability unclear; queueing vs direct dispatch ambiguous
issues.description: Full-system-flow uses Redis streams for dispatch, but FastAPI↔Laravel spec uses direct HTTP dispatch.

fix.strategy: Choose a primary dispatch mechanism; document and implement the other as optional or deprecated.

acceptance_criteria: Dispatch path is deterministic and testable under load.

issues.impact: Signature validation ambiguity and potential rejection
issues.description: Signature direction text conflicts with webhook direction; canonicalization rules exist only in markdown.

spec_evidence.path_or_quote: Laravel signs outbound webhooks using Ed25519; FastAPI signs inbound requests

fix.strategy: Clarify signature ownership per direction and encode canonicalization in JSON specs.

acceptance_criteria: Both directions pass signature verification with a single canonicalization algorithm.

issues.description: Nonce/sequence/issued_at required in signed envelopes, but schemas omit those fields.

spec_evidence.path_or_quote: Include nonce, sequence, issued_at, expires_at, and kid in every signed envelope

fix.strategy: Add nonce/sequence/issued_at/exp fields to command and telemetry envelope schemas.

acceptance_criteria: Replay attempts are rejected across services; sequences are enforced.

issues.impact: Agent JWT issuance undefined; WSS AUTH cannot be completed
issues.description: Agent JWT issuance is required but no issuance endpoint is specified.

spec_evidence.path_or_quote: Control Plane issues all user and agent JWTs

fix.strategy: Define an agent JWT issuance endpoint or embed issuance in pairing confirmation response.

acceptance_criteria: Agent can authenticate to WSS using a spec-defined JWT issuance path.

issues.impact: Telemetry and analytics requirements undefined in core specs
issues.description: Telemetry analytics API defined as missing component but not integrated into flows.

fix.strategy: Integrate telemetry analytics into telemetry summary processing and define persistence.

acceptance_criteria: Telemetry summary updates device risk scores and is queryable.

issues.impact: Artifact handling for large results not defined in JSON specs
issues.description: Full-system-flow references /api/artifact/request and presigned uploads but no JSON spec defines it.

spec_evidence.path_or_quote: Agent asks Laravel for a presigned upload URL (/api/artifact/request)

fix.strategy: Define artifact request/response schema or remove from flow docs until implemented.

acceptance_criteria: Artifact flow is fully specified and validated.
